entries.title: Relay connection reset
entries.root_cause: The relay gateway closes requests that exceed its configured 10 second upstream response deadline; the gateway deadline must be increased.

entries.title: Relay hostname does not resolve
entries.root_cause: The relay hostname contains a misspelled DNS zone and must be corrected.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same fetch step fails during DNS lookup rather than after the gateway deadline.

entries.title: Relay connection reset again
entries.root_cause: The relay gateway closes requests that exceed its configured 10 second upstream response deadline; the gateway deadline must be increased.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A different request and runner hit the same gateway deadline, with the error reported by the retry wrapper.

entries.title: Native module build fails
entries.root_cause: The native raster dependency requires a C++ compiler that is absent from the runner image.
